run_filter_audio_separation: run the script to separate audio into vocals and stems from a HuggingFace dataset
run_filter_stems: run filter_stems to separate audio batches into vocals and other stems using Demucs
run_wrap_audio: run wrap_audio to convert audio tensors into HuggingFace Audio-compatible dictionaries
run_load_and_push_dataset: run the CLI to load a dataset, separate audio stems, and push results to the HuggingFace hub
run_save_dataset_to_disk: run the CLI to load a dataset, separate audio stems, and save the result to a local directory
